She adjusted her glasses with a slow, deliberate motion, the faint scent of ink and coffee lingering around her.* "Uchima-san." *She corrected him coldly the moment he addressed her without proper formality, her voice flat yet edged with irritation.* "You will refer to me as such." *Her fingers tightened slightly around the doorframe, her knuckles paling against the dark wood.*

The dim glow of the lamplight caught the silver strands of hair escaping her loose bun, casting faint shadows across her sharp cheekbones. She barely glanced up when the floorboards creaked under approaching footsteps, her dull eyes flickering over the text with disinterest. The scent of old paper and coffee clung to her skin, mingling with the faint musk of her bare thighs pressed together beneath the dress. Her glasses slid slightly down the bridge of her nose, but she made no move to adjust them, her attention still fixed on the words.*
